orca.install_notes: Configured from the operator-downloaded ORCA 6.1.1 installer under .software_cache/orca/6.1.1 with OpenMPI 4.1.8.

required_data_resources: Explicit ResourceRefs from qe_sssp_1_3_pbe_efficiency or qe_sssp_1_3_pbe_precision, one per element; workspace ArtifactRefs remain accepted
Explicit ResourceRef to dftb_3ob_3_1 or dftb_matsci_0_3 with all required directed element-pair SKF files; workspace directory ArtifactRefs remain accepted
Explicit ResourceRefs from siesta_pseudo_dojo_nc_sr_05_pbe_standard_psml, one per element; workspace ArtifactRefs remain accepted
Explicit resource:// NequIP checkpoint or workspace model ArtifactRef
Explicit resource:// Allegro checkpoint or workspace model ArtifactRef
Explicit resource:// DeePMD model checkpoint; multitask checkpoints require a named model_branch and single-task checkpoints require model_branch=single_task
One explicit POTCAR ResourceRef or workspace ArtifactRef per element; the registered Si POTCAR is testsuite-only and no production PAW family is selected automatically
vasp.install_notes: VASP 6.3.2 was built locally from the operator-provided source. A bundled Si testsuite POTCAR validates the adapter; production use still requires the operator's licensed PAW dataset.

gnina.install_notes: Configured from registered GNINA 1.3.3 CUDA 12.8 binary; rerun scripts/configure_toolbox_resources.py to verify/relink.

required_data_resources: Explicit ResourceRefs from abinit_pseudo_dojo_nc_sr_pbe_standard_psp8, one per element; workspace ArtifactRefs remain accepted

gaussian.install_notes: Configured from the operator-provided Gaussian 16 C.01 distribution under .software_cache/gaussian/g16; the adapter accepts no arbitrary route deck.

gamess.install_notes: The registered source distribution is compiled under .software_cache/gamess/2024-r2-p1 with a sockets DDI build and isolated compiler/runtime libraries.

namd.install_notes: The AVX-512 multicore and CUDA bundles are cached under .software_cache/namd/3.0.2. The public backend selects the validated CPU AVX-512 binary only; CUDA is never chosen implicitly.

amber_pmemd.install_notes: Licensed PMEMD26 CPU serial and MPI binaries are built under .software_cache/amber/26. AmberTools 26 remains independently available in the OpenFF runtime.

charmm.install_notes: The operator-provided CHARMM c50b2 source is compiled as a serial/OpenMP GNU build under .software_cache/charmm/50b2; arbitrary CHARMM input scripts are not accepted.
